TN Supplementary Result 2026: Directorate of Government Examinations (DGE), Tamil Nadu (DGETN) has released the result for the supplementary exam conducted for Class 10, 11 and 12 students today, i.e. on 31 July 2026. The results are available on the official portal (tnresults.nic.in, dge.tn.gov.in, dge1.tn.nic.in, dge2.tn.nic.in, apply1.tndge.org). A total of 60527 students appeared in the exam. These students can download the TN 12th Supplementary Exam Result and TN +1 Supplementary Result using their roll number and date of birth. However, the TN 10th Supplementary Result was announced with the HSC +2, and +1 results. Read below to know about the steps to check the result and other important information.

TN Supplementary Exam Result 2026 at tnresults.nic.in

The online result show subject wise marks, total marks and qualifying status of the students who appeared in Tamil Nadu Class 12 (HSC) Supplementary Exam from 29 June to 07 July 2026, and in the Class 11th Supplementary Exam from 08 July to 16  July 2026. The result was announced in the form of a memo. The marks memo helps students to understand their performance in respective subjects. The direct link is provided here. Students should keep the required login details ready.

How to Get TN Supplementary Answer Sheet Copies 2026

Candidates wishing to apply for copies of their answer sheets for the June/July 2026 Higher Secondary Supplementary Exam must visit the respective District Office of the Assistant Director of Government Examinations in person on 04 August 2026 (Tuesday) and 05 August (Wednesday) between 11.00 AM and 5.00 PM. They must register by paying a fee of Rs. 275/- per subject in cash. In the districts of Chennai, Chengalpattu, Tiruvallur, and Ranipet, candidates must register by visiting the Office of the Chief Educational Officer (CEO).

TN SSLC (Class 10) Supplementary Result 2026

Tamil Nadu SSLC Supplementary Result 2026 was announced on 31st July for students who appeared in supplementary examination. The SSLC Class 10 supplementary exams were held from 8 July to 15 July 2026. Students can check marks and qualifying status online. They should keep registration number and date of birth ready.

TN SSLC 10th Supply Results 2026 Link

TN 12th Supplementary Exam Result 2026

The TN 12th Supplementary Exams were conducted from 29 June to 7 July 2026. The Tamil Nadu 12th arrear exam results was released online, today, for students who appeared in exams. Students can use their registration number and date of birth to check result. The result includes subject wise marks and qualifying status.

TN 12th Supplementary Result 2026 Link

How to Check TN Arrear 10th, 11th, 12th Result 2026 Online?

Students can check Tamil Nadu Supplementary 2026 marks memo through official portal. They need to enter required login details to view their result. Candidates can follow steps below to check result

  • Visit official website at tnresults.nic.in
  • Click on the “Result” tab
  • Then click on “Hr Sec First Year and Second Year Supplementary Exam, Jun / Jul 2026 – Result – Statement Of Marks (Provisional Certificate) Download”
  • Enter Roll Number and Date of Birth
  • Click on Submit Button
  • The result will appear on screen
  • Check details and download result
  • Take a print out for future reference

Details Mentioned on the TN SSLC, HSC +2 Supply Marks Memo 2026

TN Supplementary Marksheet 2026 will include important student and exam details. Students should check all information carefully after downloading marksheet. The marksheet TN HSC +2 includes the following details

  • Student’s Name
  • Registration Number
  • Date of Birth
  • School Name
  • Subject Names
  • Subject Wise marks
  • Total Marks
  • Result Status
  • Qualifying Status

What to Do After Downloading the TN Arrear Result 2026?

After downloading Tamil Nadu Supplementary Result 2026 students should check all details carefully. They should verify name, registration number, subject wise marks and result status. Students should save a copy of the result for future reference. They should also take a print out of provisional marksheet. If any details are incorrect, students should contact their school or the concerned board authorities.

TN SSLC, HSC +2 Supplementary Result 2026 Passing Marks

To pass TN Supplementary Exam students must score at least 35 marks out of 100 in each subject. This passing rule applies to both Class 10 & Class 12. Students must meet minimum marks requirements in every subject to qualify.

How to Apply for Revaluation or Rechecking After the Supplementary Result?

Students who are not satisfied with their marks can apply for revaluation or re-checking, if facility is available. The Board released application details after result announcement. Students can follow the steps below.

  • Visit official TNDGE website
  • Check re-evaluation or re-checking notification
  • Read eligibility and application instructions
  • Fill in requisite details
  • Select subject for re-evaluation
  • Pay requisite fee
  • Submit application before last date
  • Save confirmation page for future reference
